description: This file contains serializers, surrogates, and copiers for the SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> class within the Orleans serialization framework. It defines how SortedDictionary objects are serialized, deserialized, and deep-copied for distributed usage within Orleans.

classes.name: SortedDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer class for converting SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> to/from its surrogate representation.

classes.name: SortedDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate representation for SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> used during serialization.

classes.name: SortedDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier class for creating deep copies of SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> instances.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue>.
